Block.doc: A block id, and its data

Minecraft.create.doc: Connects to the world: mc = Minecraft.create()

Vec3.doc: A place in the world, or a direction

clearAll.doc: Forgets hits and chat not yet polled

getBlock.doc: The id of the block there

getBlockWithData.doc: The block there, with its data

getDirection.doc: Which way the player is looking

getHeight.doc: The y of the highest block that isn't air

getPitch.doc: How far up or down the player looks, in degrees

getPos.doc: Where the player is, in fractions of a block

getRotation.doc: Which way the player faces, in degrees

getTilePos.doc: The block the player is standing in

pollBlockHits.doc: Blocks hit with the sword since you last asked

pollChatPosts.doc: Chat typed since you last asked

restoreCheckpoint.doc: Puts the world back as it was at saveCheckpoint()

saveCheckpoint.doc: Remembers the world as it is now

setBlocks.doc: Fills the box between two corners

setFixed.doc: The camera stays where camera.setPos put it

setNormal.doc: The camera back in the player's eyes

withData.doc: The same block with other data: WOOL.withData(14) is red wool
